description: It hasn't been a good week to be a Bridge in the Ukraine war. While Crimea drew a lot of the attention, a much wider campaign is also playing out, with Russia targeting major Ukrainian bridges and both sides demonstrating improvements in their arsenals. So today, let's look at the battle of the bridges and unpack what these strikes might mean for the war...and whether they are or aren't worth the resources being used to go after them.
